tasks.title: Age Calculator
tasks.description: An Age Calculator is a tool that calculates a person's exact age in years, months, and days using their date of birth and the current date.

tasks.title: Even Odd Checker
tasks.description: An Even-Odd Checker is a program that checks whether a given number is even or odd. A number divisible by 2 is even; otherwise, it is odd.

tasks.title: Positive Negative Checker
tasks.description: The Positive Negative Checker identifies whether a number is positive, negative, or zero using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

tasks.title: Max of 3 Number
tasks.description: The Largest of 3 Numbers task identifies the largest among three entered numbers using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
